title: Food Chain Magnate map tile
description: Intended shape for the 20 map tiles (supplied separately). A tile is a 3x3 grid of square cells. Roads are modeled on cell edges so connectivity and tile-border crossings (range) can be computed. Place a tile into the map grid with a rotation of 0/90/180/270 degrees.

image.description: Optional path to the tile artwork.

grid.description: 3 rows x 3 columns of cells, row-major, before rotation.

road.description: Which edges of this cell carry a road segment. Roads on shared edges connect adjacent cells and tiles.

drinkSource.description: A drink symbol printed on this cell (buyers collect from an orthogonally adjacent road cell).

house.description: A printed house occupying this cell (houses can span cells; model per your renderer).

number.description: House number; determines Dinnertime processing order.

occupiable.description: Whether restaurants/marketing/new houses may be placed here (false if a printed house/road/drink already occupies it).
